# Japan Rail Club

> > Your gateway to Eastern Japan rail travel, featuring JR EAST PASS rail passes, curated regional snacks, and Shinkansen-inspired merchandise.

Japan Rail Club is the official international platform for JR East, offering rail passes for unlimited Shinkansen travel across Eastern Japan's Tohoku, Hokuriku, and surrounding regions. Members gain access to exclusive travel guides, artisan omiyage snack subscriptions, and railway-themed stationery and gifts.

## Key Topics

- JR EAST PASS
- Eastern Japan
- Tohoku Region
- Hokuriku Shinkansen
- Tohoku Shinkansen
- Shinkansen merchandise
- Onsen (hot springs)
- Winter travel
- Japanese snacks (omiyage)
- Rail passes
- Niigata
- Nagano
- Aomori
- Yamagata
- Japanese stationery

## Eastern Japan Travel Guides

- [Exploring Eastern Japan's Hot Springs: Nozawa Onsen & Ginzan Onsen](https://www.japanrailclub.com/exploring-eastern-japan-hot-springs-nozawa-onsen-ginzan-onsen): Guide to Eastern Japan hot springs: Nozawa Onsen and Ginzan Onsen
- [A Winter Wonderland at Oirase Keiryu](https://www.japanrailclub.com/th/winter-wonderland-oirase-keiryu): Winter travel guide to Oirase Keiryu in Aomori featuring snow scenery
- [Discover Mount Zao from Miyagi and Yamagata in Winter](https://www.japanrailclub.com/th/discover-mount-zao-miyagi-yamagata-winter): Winter travel guide to Mount Zao ski resort across Miyagi and Yamagata
- [The World's Fastest Art Gallery: GENBI SHINKANSEN](https://www.japanrailclub.com/ko/worlds-fastest-art-gallery-genbi-shinkansen): GENBI SHINKANSEN art gallery train running at 240km/h through Niigata
- [First Look: Hotel Metropolitan Kamakura Opens its Doors](https://www.japanrailclub.com/th/hotel-metropolitan-kamakura-opens): Opening announcement for Hotel Metropolitan Kamakura by JR-EAST HOTELS
